meta.name: The Neighborhood 720p
meta.description:
The nicest guy in the Midwest moves his family into a tough neighborhood in Los Angeles where not everyone appreciates his extreme neighborliness. That includes their new next-door neighbor Calvin.

Rated TV-PG · Ended · First aired 1 Oct 2018 · United States of America · Language: English · 22 min
Studio: Kapital Entertainment, Trill Television, A Bird and a Bear Entertainment · Network: CBS

Not complete. On your server: S1 18/21 (missing E2, E13, E19) | S2 15/22 (missing E16-22) | S3 not on server | S4 not on server | S5 not on server | S6 not on server | S7 not on server | S8 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Dave Johnson, the friendliest guy in the Midwest, moves his family to a neighborhood in Los Angeles where not everyone looks like him or appreciates his extreme neighborliness.

videos.title: Welcome to the Spare Key
videos.overview: Dave gives Calvin a spare key to the Johnsons' house in case of an emergency and is pleasantly surprised when the gesture is reciprocated - or so he thinks.

videos.title: Welcome to the Housewarming
videos.overview: When everyone but Calvin accepts Dave and Gemma's invitation to their housewarming party, Dave decides he's finally had enough of Calvin's refusal to welcome him to town.

videos.title: Welcome to Game Night
videos.overview: Unexpected revelations are in the cards during the Johnsons' first game night with the Butlers; Gemma is prompted to rectify a past wrong; Malcolm makes a play for a fresh start with his father, Calvin.

videos.title: Welcome to the Anniversary
videos.overview: Nothing goes as planned when Dave sets up an anniversary celebration for Gemma and Calvin, and Tina baby-sits the Johnsons' son, Grover.

videos.title: Welcome to the Barbershop
videos.overview: Dave is embraced by the patrons of the community barbershop, much to Calvin's dismay.

videos.title: Welcome to Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Dave and Gemma host a memorable Thanksgiving in their new home when Dave's politically incorrect mother, Paula, visits from out of town and meets Calvin, Tina and the rest of the Butler family for the first time.

videos.title: Welcome to the Dinner Guest
videos.overview: When Calvin and Tina learn Marty has a new girlfriend, Chloe, they insist he invite her over for dinner, with surprising results.

videos.title: Welcome to the Stolen Sneakers
videos.overview: When Malcolm is robbed and won't reveal the thief, Calvin and Dave team up to crack the case of the missing sneakers; Tina takes a unique approach to teaching Gemma self-defense.

videos.title: Welcome to the Fundraiser
videos.overview: Tina gets carried away when she tries to help Gemma ace her first fundraiser as school principal; Dave tries to help Calvin win a special silent auction prize for his mom.

videos.title: Welcome to Grover's Birthday
videos.overview: When Dave and Gemma's elaborate plans for Grover's 7th birthday party go awry, Malcolm and Marty come to the rescue. Also, Calvin’s choice of gift winds up sending one person to the hospital.

videos.title: Welcome to the Yard Sale
videos.overview: Dave convinces Calvin to hold a yard sale, but when longtime neighborhood resident Miss Simpson makes a purchase Calvin quickly regrets, he enlists Dave to help him get the valuable object back.

videos.title: Welcome to Malcolm's Job
videos.overview: When Tina agrees to give Grover piano lessons and her son Malcolm lands a job in retail sales, neither Butler has a first day that goes quite according to plan.

videos.title: Welcome to the Big Payback
videos.overview: When Gemma has her car repaired at Calvin’s shop, Tina insists she doesn’t need to pay for the work, to Calvin’s consternation. Also, Malcolm and Marty find themselves on the same dating app and vying for the same woman’s attention.

videos.title: Welcome to the Climb
videos.overview: When Gemma decides to fire a teacher at her school, she’s unprepared for the aftermath. Also, Calvin gets a surprise when he faces off with his newspaper carrier.

videos.title: Welcome to Logan #2
videos.overview: When Calvin and Dave’s college basketball teams go head to head, Dave surprises the Butlers with tickets to the game and also invites one of his best friends from Michigan, Logan #2, who reveals to Calvin surprising new details about Dave.

videos.title: Welcome to the Repass
videos.overview: When a curmudgeonly resident with few fans in the community passes away, the Butlers step up to host a memorial, leading Calvin to an unexpected revelation about himself.

videos.title: Welcome to the Conversation
videos.overview: Dave is thrilled when Calvin invites him golfing, confident that it represents progress in their relationship, but Calvin may have another motive. Also, Gemma and Tina team up to pull off an unforgettable surprise for Malcolm, Marty and Grover

videos.title: Welcome to the Re-Rack
videos.overview: One year after the Johnsons moved next door to the Butlers, Dave is eager to take on a bigger role in Calvin’s annual Yardecue and prove how much a part of the community he’s become. But Calvin’s reaction makes it clear that, while the relationship between the two families has grown, the friendship between Calvin and Dave still has a way to go.

videos.title: Welcome to the Bully
videos.overview: When Grover gets into a fight with a bully at school, Gemma is torn between her role as principal and wanting to protect her son; Calvin encourages Marty to stand up to his own bully, only to be shocked when he learns who it is.

videos.title: Welcome to the Fresh Coat
videos.overview: When Tina decides it's time to make home improvements, Dave volunteers to repaint the Butler house, violating Calvin’s “man code” and setting off a chain of events that impacts both families.

videos.title: Welcome to Co-Habitation
videos.overview: When Dave accidentally knocks out the Butlers' power during a heat wave, Calvin and Tina spend the night at the Johnsons' home. Malcolm has some fun at Marty's expense when he crashes at his little brother's refurbished apartment.

videos.title: Welcome to Soul Food
videos.overview: The Butlers and Johnsons decide to go on a double-date and everyone gets more than they bargained for at a new restaurant. Grover invites Malcolm and Marty to be the first guests on his new podcast.

videos.title: Welcome to the Wagon
videos.overview: Dave and Tina discover a common bond when they attend a concert together. Gemma seeks the Butlers' help when an unwelcome visitor takes up residence in the Johnson home.

videos.title: Welcome to the Vow Renewal
videos.overview: As Calvin and Tina near a milestone anniversary, Dave and Gemma decide to help the Butlers have the wedding they missed out on the first time around. Also, Malcolm and Marty prepare an unforgettable performance for their parents’ special occasion.

videos.title: Welcome to Bowling
videos.overview: With Calvin down a teammate for his annual bowling championship, Dave offers to fill in and soon finds his mediation skills put to the test when he meets the competition: Calvin’s arch-rivals, the Pink Ladies. Also, Gemma and Tina dare to face off against each other for the top ranking in an arcade game.

videos.title: Welcome to the Dealbreaker
videos.overview: When Gemma sets a reluctant Malcolm up on a blind date with a teacher at her school, she discovers new details about the origins of her relationship with Dave. Also, Marty helps Calvin and Tina plan for their future

videos.title: Welcome to the Digital Divide
videos.overview: Calvin reluctantly agrees to let Marty create a website for his auto shop in the hopes of drumming up more business. Also, with Gemma out of town for a school retreat, Dave makes it his mission to prove to his son, Grover, that there's more to life than his favorite gadgets.

videos.title: Welcome to the Scooter
videos.overview: When the Johnsons' Christmas present for Grover is stolen, Calvin and Dave team up to recover the gift in time for the holiday; a nostalgic Tina tries to get into the Christmas spirit by reviving traditions from when Malcolm and Marty were kids.

videos.title: Welcome to the Freeloader
videos.overview: Dave's patience is tested when Gemma's freeloading sister, Brittany (Deborah Baker Jr.), suddenly shows up with plans for an extended stay. Also, Calvin grows frustrated that Malcolm is still living at home, even with a new job

videos.title: Welcome to the New Pastor
videos.overview: Tina spends time with the charming new minister she helped select for her church; Calvin suspects the man may be coveting more than just job security; Marty gets a surprise when he finally meets his disruptive, new upstairs neighbor.

videos.title: Welcome to Trivia Night
videos.overview: When Calvin and Dave get shown up by Gemma and Marty at a local bar's trivia night, the pair hatch a plan for a do-over to redeem themselves. Also, a frustrated Tina decides to take matters into her own hands in order to finally meet Malcolm's girlfriend, Sofia.

videos.title: Welcome to the Bad Review
videos.overview: Dave puts his professional conflict mediator skills to the test when he offers to help Calvin find out why his employees are quitting. Also, Marty devises an elaborate plan to help him earn a date with his new upstairs neighbor.
